_comment: Site configuration used by the weather layer only. The orbit engine keeps its own site file (backend/engine/data/site_canso.json). Nothing here is hard-coded in source (spec II.10).

canso.name: Spaceport Nova Scotia, Canso
canso.coordinates_source: Canso Spaceport Facility Environmental Assessment Registration Document (Strum Consulting for Maritime Launch Services, June 2018), section 5.1: 'The Project site (centered at 45 deg 18' 37.40" N, 060 deg 59' 35.85" W)'. Read 2026-10-03. The spec default of 45.3 N, 61.0 W selects the same 0.25 degree weather grid cell.

evaluation_window_local.source: Canso Spaceport Facility Environmental Assessment Registration Document (Strum Consulting for Maritime Launch Services, June 2018), section 2.3. The spec repeats it as the nominal operating hours (spec IV.5).
evaluation_window_local.source_quote: The majority of launches will be conducted between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m.
evaluation_window_local.use: The frozen Seam 1 signature takes a date and no time, so the window interval I(d) of spec II.20 is these hours. Hourly values labelled 07:00 to 12:00 local, both included, are evaluated.

populated_places.source: Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Geographical Names Database, geogratis.gc.ca/services/geoname, read 2026-10-03. The three places are the communities the environmental assessment names: 'near the communities of Little Dover, Hazel Hill, and Canso'.
